title: State land mammal.
bodyText: The ōpe`ape`a, otherwise known as the Hawaiian hoary bat (Lasiurus cinereus semotus), is established and designated as the official land mammal of the State.
bodyHtml: [§5-12.2]  State land mammal.  The ōpe`ape`a, otherwise known as the Hawaiian hoary bat (Lasiurus cinereus semotus), is established and designated as the official land mammal of the State. [L 2015, c 13, §2]
